findings.text: the record presents $0.9546 as spend 'within the coordinator's USD 2.00 ceiling for the resume', but the node's own done_when required that no paid LLM call be made and its brief set budget USD 0, so the $0.42 spent in the first build ran under no authorized budget and the clause is not satisfied as written; the coordinator's later resume advice authorizes the USD 2.00 ceiling, so the deviation is disclosed and supervised rather than concealed.

the record quotes the CLI summary's '0 cluster nodes' verbatim while the same run logs 'Merging 3025 cluster nodes' at imas_dd_dd.log:34010 and leaves 2201 clusters in the graph, because that field reads stats['clusters_created'] at imas_codex/cli/imas_dd.py:598 and the merge phase creates through another path, so a reader taking the quoted line at face value believes no clusters were touched.

the record states the per-call cost=$ lines are 'the only record of this spend', but the same log records 'Build metadata: duration=619s, enrich=$13.9424, refine=$17.2729, total=$31.2153' at imas_dd_dd.log:34043 and again at 34167, so a reader reconciling spend meets an unexplained figure 30x the quoted total; the record should say the metadata line is cumulative build metadata, not this run's spend.
